questions.question: What does a favourable bank statement balance mean from the perspective of the bank?
questions.expected_answer: It is a liability to the bank; they owe the business money, so it is a credit balance.

questions.question: Why do we place outstanding cheques in the debit column of the bank reconciliation statement?
questions.expected_answer: Because when the bank eventually processes them, they will debit the account to reduce their liability to the business.

questions.question: How do you determine the Bank Account balance from the reconciliation statement?
questions.expected_answer: By finding the balancing figure between the debit and credit columns. A debit balancing figure means a favourable ledger balance.
